scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Deterministic well-mixed autonomous model (equation (6) of arXiv:2308.09530v1), fixed parameters, strictly interior starts; all positive relative timescale ratios and critical thresholds.
scientific_integrity.limitation: No assertion for stochastic, spatial, switched or delayed models, or uniqueness of all closed-rectangle equilibria. Nonhyperbolic threshold convergence not asserted exponential. Numerical tests only supplement proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Monotonic reward nullcline and explicit separable Lyapunov function with LaSalle invariance.

title: A global Lyapunov phase diagram for adaptive institutional rewards
